name: Argoverse 1
summary: 面向三维跟踪与运动预测的自动驾驶数据集，结合车辆轨迹、传感器日志和高清地图，为地图条件未来预测建立了重要基准。
summaryEn: An autonomous-driving dataset for 3D tracking and motion forecasting, combining trajectories, sensor logs, and HD maps for map-conditioned future prediction.
scaleZh: 113 段跟踪日志 · 32.4 万+ 条运动预测序列
organizations: Argo AI and Carnegie Mellon University
license: Argoverse Terms of Use; research-oriented access
licenseZh: 适用 Argoverse 使用条款；主要面向研究用途
verdict: 地图条件运动预测基准
wmNote: 适合历史基线复现；新项目通常优先使用 Argoverse 2，但第一版仍有大量可比结果。
wmNoteEn: Valuable for historical comparability, while Argoverse 2 is generally preferred for new work.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1911.02620] Argoverse: 3D Tracking and Forecasting with Rich Maps
evidence.statement: Tracked agent trajectories with rich maps include a dedicated five-second motion-forecasting dataset and 3D tracking sequences.
